page.title: Email
page.description: Configure this site's mail transport and review every delivery

status.heading: Mail transport
status.description: With no usable transport, features that send email hide their entry points instead of accepting requests they cannot fulfil

config.heading: Mail transport settings
config.description: Blank fields fall back to the platform default; leave everything blank to use it entirely
config.driverHint: Log-only never sends anything; it writes the full message to the server log. Unavailable in production
config.fromHint: Recipients check SPF/DKIM against this address, so it must be a domain you control
config.smtpSecureHint: On for port 465; off for 587, which uses STARTTLS and will fail the handshake if this is on
config.smtpPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep it unchanged; save a single space to clear the site password

test.heading: Send test email
test.description: Send a test message to confirm the transport really works
